title: Declarative Attention
description: Read less KV. Move no KV. An interactive, explicitly simulated journey from an empty GPU to selective attention.

narration.title: An empty GPU
narration.text: This is a GPU. The math happens here. Its memory is here. It plugs into a computer, through a cable called PCIe.

cues.text: This is a GPU.

narration.title: Weights arrive
narration.text: The model's weights travel over PCIe and stay in GPU memory.

cues.text: The model's weights travel over PCIe

narration.title: A long request
narration.text: A long request arrives: four documents, C1 to C4, plus SYS: the instructions and the question. The question: how many years did the project take?

cues.text: A long request arrives: four documents, C1 to C4,

narration.title: Build the KV cache
narration.text: The GPU reads it once, storing every token in a KV cache. Each document gets its own seat.

cues.text: The GPU reads it once, storing every token in a KV cache.

narration.title: Read everything
narration.text: For each new word, global attention reads every seat again. The dots are data being read, not moved.

cues.text: For each new word, global attention reads every seat again.

narration.title: Pay again, every token
narration.text: Next word: all thirty-three megabytes, read again. Every word pays this. With long prompts, this reading is the slow part.

cues.text: Next word: all thirty-three megabytes, read again.

narration.title: Declare where to look
narration.text: Declarative attention lets the model say where to look. It writes a note: focus C3. Now only C3 is read. The rest dim, but stay put. What will the next word read?

narration.title: Read less
narration.text: Just SYS, C3 and the reply so far. About a quarter of the reading. Memory use: unchanged. Did anything get freed?

narration.title: What the paper measured
narration.text: In the paper: fifty-two percent fewer tokens read, for about 1.3 points less accuracy. Their measurement, not this demo's.

narration.title: Look around again
narration.text: Unsure? Switch back to global and read everything. Nothing reloads. It never left.

narration.title: Answer from what you know
narration.text: Local mode skips every document. SYS and the reply are enough to answer: eight years. Why is the read bar still above zero?

narration.title: The seats never changed
narration.text: Read less KV. Move no KV. Your turn: click a seat, decode a word, watch the bar.
